facts.fact: The Code de procédure pénale of 13 December 2024 requires the judicial police officer's procès-verbaux to be drafted on the spot and signed on each sheet by the officer and the persons heard (art. 132), the originals sent directly to the prosecutor (art. 34), a receipt issued at once for every complaint (art. 30) and heads of police units and gendarmerie brigades to send the prosecutor monthly statements of their files (art. 36); the passages read provide no electronic form for the procès-verbal or the complaint.

systems.country_label: registre de garde à vue; registre spécial
systems.owner: Officers of the judicial police, Police nationale and Gendarmerie nationale
systems.tiers: Every police or gendarmerie premises that may hold a person in custody; numbered and initialled by the president of the tribunal (art. 115); the special register may be kept in dematerialised form (art. 128)

systems.country_label: fichiers d'antécédents; traitements automatisés de données à caractère personnel
systems.owner: Police nationale and Gendarmerie nationale, under a magistrate named by the justice minister
systems.tiers: The law permits the two forces to run them on data gathered in inquiries (art. 409); direct access for prosecutors, access by mobile means for authorised personnel (arts. 415-416); an implementing decree is to follow (art. 417)

systems.owner: Judicial police services and units of the Police nationale and Gendarmerie nationale, under judicial control
systems.tiers: Permitted by art. 418 for serial crimes and offences; an implementing decree is to follow (art. 423)
Holds warrants, search orders and court-ordered bans and obligations (art. 424); no tier stated

systems.owner: Judicial police services of the Police nationale and Gendarmerie nationale, and Customs, under judicial control
systems.tiers: Permitted by art. 425 to cross-match information on methods gathered in inquiries; no tier stated

systems.system: Fichiers de police ou de gendarmerie (relevés signalétiques)
systems.country_label: fichiers de police ou de gendarmerie
systems.tiers: Fed and consulted with fingerprints, palm prints and photographs taken by or under a judicial police officer (art. 87)

systems.system: Fichier national automatisé des empreintes génétiques
systems.country_label: fichier national automatisé des empreintes génétiques
systems.owner: Under the control of a magistrate
systems.tiers: National, centralised (art. 1251); judicial police officers may order entries and comparisons (arts. 1251, 1253)

systems.system: Casier judiciaire national centralisé et informatisé
systems.owner: A service created for the purpose (art. 1330); registry of each tribunal and the Bamako Court of Appeal for the special record
systems.tiers: National and centralised; the registries of the tribunals of first instance receive the record cards (arts. 1289-1291, 1302, 1330)

note: A law, read as passages (the paragraphs carrying a study term, of 130,405 words): the one fact is the form the statute prescribes for the procès-verbal, not a statement of what stations do; the files and registers it authorises are permissions, with decrees still to come.
